sample_unit: FDA-marketed AI/ML medical devices (approximate count; adverse event reports in MAUDE)

links.outcome: Adequacy of FDA MAUDE adverse event reporting for assessing safety of AI/ML devices
links.effect: Analysis of adverse event data for approximately 950 AI/ML devices found the existing FDA adverse event reporting system insufficient for properly assessing safety and effectiveness of AI/ML devices.
links.quote: In particular, we evaluate the data pertaining to adverse events associated with approximately 950 medical devices incorporating AI/ML functions for devices approved between 2010 through 2023, and we find that the existing system is insufficient for properly assessing the safety and effectiveness of AI/ML devices.

unlisted_practices: FDA changes to adverse event reporting specific to AI/ML devices

screen.reason: Empirical analysis characterizing real-world adverse event reports (MAUDE database) for ~950 FDA-cleared AI/ML devices to assess postmarket surveillance sufficiency, along with policy recommendations.
